**Three measured full-step ratios** (reference/candidate median times, seeds 21005–21007):

- 3.7747 / 3.6905 ms → **1.0228**

**Scope limitation:** The ratios apply only to the tested single-layer FP32 local-fallback path with synthetic tokens. They do **not** establish a production model speedup, FP16/BF16 full-model behavior, Transformer Engine behavior, or any general Hopper/Blackwell instruction equivalent.
